headline: Wave B4 (4 rdloop DSP-augmentation arms screened against B2f, 16.23 GPU h). Only B4a (--aug_apm_p 0.3) has a positive verdict, on the final readout: +1.02 [+0.43, +1.60], merge +0.57 [-0.01, +1.17]. Its gain is on the matched set and clean; the pre-registered NS mechanism is refuted (rank 3/3 vs placebos). B4b (opus_plc) is null and REFUTED with 3 placebos, and flagged ANOMALOUS. B4c (dtx_gate) is null and NOT SHOWN, under-dosed (ratio 0.032). The dose step B4d (p 0.6) is null: it fired 'no dose response' and 'trade-off' (noisy spoof misses 46 > 35). So B2f stays the supervisor's best. B4a's configuration goes to a seed-gated full run, and the final epoch beat the merge in 5/5 runs.

recommended_full_run.base_run: SLS_setup/exp/B4a_qwen17_rtc_musan_loud23_cos8_lr2.5e6_apmns03_s1234_epoch8_bs16_20261018150134 (B4a configuration = B2f argv + --aug_apm_p 0.3), with one paired B2f-configuration control (same argv without --aug_apm_p) at seed 1235. Run order: B4a s1235, then control s1235, then B4a s1236 (~12.6 GPU h). The supervisor's best stays B2f until the owner gate passes.
recommended_full_run.flags: cd SLS_setup && /root/.conda/envs/rtc-sdd/bin/python -u -m b4wave.train --train_data_path /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/wav/train --train_protocol /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/train_label.txt --dev_data_path /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/wav/dev --dev_protocol ../data/dev_noisy_sim/dev_label_excl_halfB.txt --ssl_name Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B --n_layers 24 --batch_size 16 --num_epochs 8 --num_workers 64 --use_rtc_aug --aug_noise_dirs ../data/augmentation_train/rnnoise ../data/augmentation_train/esc50 --aug_rir_dirs ../data/augmentation_train/rirs --musan --musan_dir ../data/augmentation/musan --loudness_norm --loudness_norm_lufs -23 --optim adamw --lr 2.5e-6 --head_lr_mult 10 --weight_decay 0.01 --lr_scheduler warmup_cosine --warmup_frac 0.05 --lr_min 5e-7 --grad_clip 1.0 --ema_decay 0.9995 --local_eval_sets ../configs/local_eval_sets.yaml --earlystop_metric wf1 --earlystop_epoch 99 --keep_topk_by_wf1 7 --keep_epochs 8 --aug_apm_p 0.3 --seed <SEED> --track FB4_qwen17_rtc_musan_loud23_cos8_lr2.5e6_apmns03_s<SEED>   (control: same command without --aug_apm_p 0.3, --track FB4ctl_qwen17_rtc_musan_loud23_cos8_lr2.5e6_s1235)
recommended_full_run.readout: Per seed, read the final-epoch EMA checkpoint (ckpt/epoch_8_*.pth scored into local_eval/epoch_8 on half_B: the 17 report sets via --names, with --loudness_norm --loudness_norm_lufs -23). B4a's positive verdict is on this readout, and the final beat the merge in all 5 wave runs. Owner gate: promote B4a's configuration only if (a) FB4-s1235-final vs FB4ctl-s1235-final passes the promote rule (paired CI low > 0, clean drop <= 0.5) and (b) FB4-s1236-final is above both B2f-ep8 (92.14) and FB4ctl-s1235. Otherwise B2f stays and FB4ctl-s1235 becomes its second seed. Submit the score average of the winning configuration's final checkpoints if it beats every seed on half_B; otherwise submit its single best final checkpoint. Pack the zip with /post-train-eval: only top-5-merge zips exist today; the current B2f submission is B2f/model_merging_top5/submission.zip.

follow_ups: 1. --aug_apm_ns_levels 18 21 on B4a's configuration (= coupled group --aug_apm_p 0.3 --aug_apm_ns_levels 18 21 vs B2f), only if the seed gate promotes B4a. Target: heldout afftdn bona (half-B recall 55.4/58.1 on B2f). The only NS-specific signal is afftdn-vs-anlmdn, rank 1/3 at both doses (-1.39/-1.05 final, DIRECTIONAL). Predicted: afftdn DiD <= -1.70 and heldout F1 >= 89.31, with noisy spoof misses <= 35. Falsifier: afftdn DiD > -0.84.

2. --aug_apm_p 0.3 on B3a's configuration (one flag vs B3a), only if the owner adopts B3a as the cross-wave reference and the gate passes. B3a's gain is heldout ranking (+2.28) with a final clean drop of 0.63; B4a's is matched (+1.24/+1.56) and clean (+0.35). Predicted: merge delta vs B3a > +0.5 with CI low > 0 and clean drop <= 0.5. Falsifier: delta within +-0.5, or heldout down > 1.0.

3. --aug_opus_plc_p 0.3 --aug_opus_loss 0 0 vs B2f (the plan's zero-loss attribution control; also the 4th placebo for the NS-specific signals). Hypothesis: the aligned libopus decode, not the packet loss, gave B4b's matched +0.86 on the merge. Predicted: matched delta >= +0.5 on both readouts and VAD z < +3. Falsifier: matched < +0.5 with WF1 in band closes the opus family.

4. --aug_dtx_p 1.0 vs B2f (cap test of the flag-level dtx line; the per-clip dose stays near 0.03). Predicted: VAD DiD <= -1.05, rank 1/4, and criterion (ii) >= 0 on half B. Falsifier: VAD DiD >= -0.64, or matched R_spoof down > 0.5 again. A real dose fix (shorter hangover) is a code change for rdloop.
5. Seed repeat --seed 1235 of B2f (last). It is folded into the full run as the paired control. It is outside B4's search space, so it needs an owner decision.
